exceptions.detail: React Date Picker retains same-day clock changes at minute/second precision. Compose Date Picker uses CivilDate and has no integrated time selection; standalone time controls do not close that gap.

Month/week/day/agenda source, CRUD, IANA zone projection, RRULE/EXDATE subset, scoped changes, immutable undo, overlap lanes and pointer/keyboard move-resize exist. Seventeen canonical color triples and light/dark rest/hover/past washes are generated and applied. Native execution and DST/device fixtures are unrun. All-day/multiple-calendar source handling, custom hue/chroma colors, complete series-exception retargeting, recurrence date syntax and every web setting are not complete. DST fold/gap visual layout and cross-zone pointer behavior need qualification.

Typed block/run/mark document source, range transactions, source-preserving Markdown subset, validated JSON schema adapter, slash commands, table/image editing and undo exist. Cross-block platform selection/IME edges, complete CommonMark/GFM/extension-kit behavior, nested list input rules, block drag and full table operations are incomplete. Native text input, resource decoding and serialization fixtures have not run on Android or JVM.

Source includes filtering, sort, pagination, row selection, column visibility/order/width/pinning state, pinned viewport panels, lazy rows and validated cell editing. Full web grouping/aggregation, column drag reorder/resize, nested expansion and custom cell/accessibility combinations are incomplete or unqualified. No native runtime has verified scrolling, focus or large-data behavior.

Each family has native geometry. Cartesian nullable gaps/stable palette/legend hiding and keyboard selection exist; StatusBar has canonical uptime-period data, semantic statuses, latest-fitting pills, inspector and table. Other families lack complete multi-series/options, shared paint/format models, full legend/keyboard/table interactions, pie folding, squarified treemap and canonical transition behavior. Geometry and accessibility have not been qualified on native targets.

All 32 source compositions have individual ports and real local actions. Source-level authentication rules distinguish login/signup/email-only templates. No Kotlin block has been compiled or visually inspected. Responsive geometry, platform input and every content/layout comparison remain unverified; AppShell04 still needs actual host window integration.

Canonical shapes/eye contours, all states/styles and 17 named colors, frame interpolation, blink, pointer gaze and motion/window policy exist. Sampled loops do not cover every independent web gesture period, and full interrupted cross-state morph behavior is incomplete. Native frame cadence, custom color contrast and resource memory cost are unqualified.

Responsive Compose navigation, mobile sheets, tabs and optional panels exist. Full web App Shell configurator/peek/reorder/window behaviors and operating-system menu/tray/shortcut integration are incomplete. Desktop host currently creates a normal native JVM window; no fake window controls stand in for native integration. The header's page menu (AppShellHeaderActions menu, added 2026-11-17) is not ported.

Native PCM adapters consume canonical oscillator recipes and master level. Exact Web Audio bandpass/Q, exponential envelope/glide, voice/retrigger/humanization and audible cross-platform identity are not fully matched or tested. Audio hardware/error behavior has not been verified.

Native basic Markdown blocks/inline links, tables/tasks and fenced code exist, with a small lexer for highlighting. Full CommonMark/GFM/math/embedded media behavior and maintained grammars for every advertised language are not implemented.

Canonical default light/dark tokens, density steps, Inter fonts, control press scales and timing curves, outline/monochrome brand geometry and all 22 spinner patterns are generated. Full runtime look/palette/font options, exact layered shadows/materials, transition behavior outside mapped controls, and icon optical scaling/duotone/animated recipes are incomplete. OS reduced-motion, font variation weights, focus/accessibility semantics and phone/tablet/desktop visual baselines are unverified.

Android uses the system document picker, MediaPlayer/VideoView and platform media controls. Desktop uses a system file chooser and OpenJFX media surface. Native picker/media chrome and supported codecs differ from web controls. These adapters have not been executed in this session.

The web screen blocks added on 2026-11-17 have no Compose compositions yet. The block catalog lists them and its router shows its unknown-block placeholder; ports follow per block, starting with the auth blocks, whose rules are pure modules.
